integrity: All stated finite bounds and enumeration counts were independently recomputed with two standalone, structurally different C++17 programs using integer-only exhaustive searches; detailed reproducible source and numerical witnesses are included. This is a same-model verification, not an independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact finite census only for n=2,...,7, using undirected induced Lucas cubes, closed radius-one neighborhoods, and coordinate-dihedral invariance; no claim for larger dimensions, erasures, or alternative observability definitions. Historical novelty is qualified by the possibility of unindexed prior calculations.
title: Dihedral identifying-code penalties in Lucas cubes through dimension seven
